facts.value: For each passed examination, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University. This certificate will be issued in bilingual format (German and English). You can use this language certificate for your applications abroad or later during your job search.

Courses for all students: You can only find out your grades once you receive your certificate via email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the examination date. Elective module courses and Master’s Course: You can view your grades password-protected in QIS.
